figures.finding: Andorra's artists' statute makes an artist's pay (actors, screenwriters and audiovisual directors among them) whatever the collective agreement or the contract sets, never below the statutory minimum wage, which from 1 July 2026 is EUR 9.05 an hour, EUR 72.40 a day of 8 hours or EUR 1,568.66 a month for any employee aged 15 or over.
